description.message: Let a paired NoBot control dedicated extension-owned tabs

pairing.message: Paste pairing string (contains a secret; do not share)

security.message: The paired server can read login credentials and act on these websites. Only pair servers you trust.

failed.message: Operation failed. Check your connection and pairing.

addressHint.message: The address the extension uses to reach NoBot, e.g. a VPN IP: http://192.168.1.10:3000. Changing it keeps the pairing. LAN / VPN addresses may use http; anything else must be https.

pausedHint.message: While paused, every NoBot operation is refused; the connection stays up

revokeConfirm.message: The extension will disconnect and delete its pairing. Continue?

noDebugger.message: This browser does not support the debugger API (chrome.debugger), so the extension cannot control pages.
